newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Cisneros Group forms television unit.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Cisneros Group forms television unit.

text.p: The Cisneros Group of Companies, one of Latin America's leading business organizations, announced Monday that it had created a new division dedicated to television broadcasting and production.

The Miami-based Cisneros Television Group (CTG) will be entirely owned by the Cisneros Group of Companies, Andres Rodriguez, of the Cisneros Group corporate strategy division in New York, told Reuters by telephone.
"However, when we develop new channels we take on partners," Rodriguez said.

Among its first ventures will be "Locomotion," a 24-hour animation programming service developed with Hearst Corp which will begin servcice for 23 countries in Latin America and the Carribean in November via Hughes Electronic's DIRECTV. Rodriguez said the Cisneros Television Group would announce new programming partnerships shortly.

In forming the Cisneros Television Group we are taking an important step toward implementing the Cisneros Group's stated strategy of focusing on the media and entertainment industry," Cisneros Group Chairman Gustavo Cisneros was quoted as saying in a release.

"The Cisneros Television Group will aggressively identify entertainment areas which are underserved in Latin America and will create programming to fill those niches," added Carlos Cisneros, Managing Director of the Cisneros Group.
Affiliates of the Cisneros Group include Venevision, Venezuela's largest commercial network, and Venevision International, which distributes Spanish-language programming throughout the world.
The Group holds an interest in Galaxy Latin America, the Florida-based joint venture that delivers DIRECTV service to Latin America.
The Cisneros broadcasting interests also extend to a significant stake in of U.S. Spanish language network Univision Communications Inc, Chilevision in Chile and CCN of Trinidad and Tobago.
